# porch_role (Data Source)

Looks up a role of a tenant by ID or slug, including the built-in `admin` and `member` roles.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Built-in roles: "admin" (*:*) and "member".
data "porch_role" "admin" {
  tenant = "smiths"
  slug   = "admin"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tenant` (String) Tenant ID or slug.

### Optional

- `id` (String) Role ID. Exactly one of `id` and `slug` must be set.
- `slug` (String) Role slug, e.g. `admin`.

### Read-Only

- `built_in` (Boolean) Whether the role is built in.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `includes` (Set of String) Bundled role IDs.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `permissions` (Set of String) Permissions.
